image_description: A single Australian Pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus) floating on calm, greyish water. The bird is facing left, with its long, pale orange bill dipping into the water. It has white plumage on the head, neck, and chest, contrasting with black flight feathers on the wings. A clear reflection of the pelican is visible in the water below.
